mineral_based_product.label: Mineral-based product
mineral_based_product.value: Asphalt roofing shingles, glass-fiber insulation, glass-fiber nonwoven veils and facers, Foamglas cellular glass insulation, glass-fiber composites

thermal_processing_dependence.label: Thermal-processing dependence
thermal_processing_dependence.value: Glass-melting furnaces produce glass fiber for insulation, composites and veils; asphalt coating lines make shingles

energy_fuel_intensity.label: Energy / fuel intensity
energy_fuel_intensity.value: Energy-intensive glass melting, mainly natural gas and electricity; asphalt heating for roofing

delivery_radius_product_logistics.label: Delivery radius / product logistics
delivery_radius_product_logistics.value: Regional manufacturing plants serving North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific; products shipped through distribution to contractors and builders

construction_end_use.label: Construction end use
construction_end_use.value: Residential and commercial roofing, wall and roof-deck insulation, ceilings, gypsum board and building envelope; also flooring, interiors and industrial markets

raw_material_integration_model.label: Raw-material / integration model
raw_material_integration_model.value: Purchased and some owned mineral inputs such as sand, limestone and asphalt; vertically integrated into glass fiber and shingle manufacturing

notes: Process, energy and logistics facets rely on general knowledge of Owens Corning; website evidence is limited to products.
